ko.title: 하나의 폴드, 세 대의 전화: 9월 9일 애플의 iPhone Ultra 승부수 속으로

segments.src: Apple has invited the press to a September 9 event billed internally, according to multiple supply-chain and media reports, as "Surprise and Shine" — and the surprise this year looks bigger than a new camera bump or a fresh color option.
segments.tr: 애플은 여러 공급망 및 언론 보도에 따르면 내부적으로 "Surprise and Shine"으로 명명된 9월 9일 행사에 언론을 초청했으며, 올해의 깜짝 선물은 새로운 카메라 범프나 신선한 색상 옵션보다 더 커 보입니다.

segments.src: For the first time in the iPhone's history, Apple is reportedly preparing to ship a folding handset, arriving alongside a refreshed iPhone 18 Pro lineup built on a new 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip.
segments.tr: iPhone 역사상 처음으로 애플은 새로운 2나노미터 A20 Pro 칩을 기반으로 구축된 리프레시된 iPhone 18 Pro 라인업과 함께 폴딩 핸드셋의 출시를 준비 중인 것으로 알려졌습니다.

segments.src: If the reports hold up, it would mark the most significant hardware shift for the iPhone since the move to Face ID in 2017 — and a calculated gamble at a moment when global smartphone upgrade cycles have grown longer and harder to disrupt.
segments.tr: 보도가 사실이라면 이는 2017년 Face ID로 전환된 이후 iPhone의 가장 중요한 하드웨어 변화이자, 전 세계 스마트폰 교체 주기가 길어지고 깨뜨리기 어려워진 시점에 던진 계산된 승부수가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What's Reportedly Coming
segments.tr: ## 공개될 것으로 알려진 내용

segments.src: Based on leaks circulating among display suppliers and component makers in Asia, here is the shape analysts expect the lineup to take:
segments.tr: 아시아의 디스플레이 공급업체 및 부품 제조업체들 사이에서 흘러나오는 유출 정보를 바탕으로, 분석가들이 예상하는 라인업의 윤곽은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **iPhone Ultra (foldable):** A book-style folding design with a crease-reduction hinge system, an outer cover display for quick tasks, and a large internal screen aimed at productivity and media use — Apple's answer to years of foldable phones from Samsung and Chinese rivals.
segments.tr: - **iPhone Ultra (폴더블):** 주름 개선 힌지 시스템, 빠른 작업을 위한 외부 커버 디스플레이, 생산성과 미디어 활용을 겨냥한 대형 내부 화면을 갖춘 북 스타일 폴딩 디자인 — 삼성과 중국 경쟁사들의 오랜 폴더블폰에 대한 애플의 해답입니다.

segments.src: - **iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max:** Expected to carry the new A20 Pro chip, said to be the first Apple silicon built on a 2nm process, promising meaningful gains in efficiency and on-device AI performance.
segments.tr: - **iPhone 18 Pro 및 Pro Max:** 2nm 공정으로 제작된 최초의 Apple silicon으로 알려진 새로운 A20 Pro 칩을 탑재하여 효율성과 온디바이스 AI 성능의 의미 있는 향상을 제공할 것으로 기대됩니다.

segments.src: - **Camera and battery updates:** Incremental but notable improvements are rumored across the Pro models, continuing Apple's pattern of pairing major design years with quieter internal refinements.
segments.tr: - **카메라 및 배터리 업데이트:** Pro 모델 전반에 걸쳐 점진적이지만 주목할 만한 개선이 이루어질 것이라는 소문이 있으며, 이는 주요 디자인 변경 연도에 조용한 내부 개선을 결합하는 애플의 패턴을 이어가는 것입니다.

segments.src: Apple has not confirmed any of these details publicly, and as with every pre-launch cycle, specifics could change before the keynote actually streams.
segments.tr: 애플은 이러한 세부 사항을 공개적으로 확인하지 않았으며, 모든 출시 전 주기와 마찬가지로 키노트가 실제로 스트리밍되기 전에 구체적인 내용이 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why a Foldable, Why Now
segments.tr: ## 왜 폴더블인가, 왜 지금인가

segments.src: The smartphone market Apple is selling into today looks very different from the one it entered in 2007.
segments.tr: 오늘날 애플이 판매하고 있는 스마트폰 시장은 2007년에 진입했던 시장과는 매우 달라 보입니다.

segments.src: Global unit growth has flattened, replacement cycles have stretched toward four years in many markets, and premium buyers increasingly ask "why upgrade?"
segments.tr: 전 세계 출하량 성장은 정체되었고, 많은 시장에서 교체 주기가 4년 가까이 늘어났으며, 프리미엄 구매자들은 점점 더 "어떤 모델을 살까?"가 아니라

segments.src: rather than "which model?"
segments.tr: "왜 업그레이드해야 하지?"

segments.src: A genuinely new form factor is one of the few levers left that can reset that calculus.
segments.tr: 라고 묻고 있습니다. 진정으로 새로운 폼 팩터는 그러한 계산을 리셋할 수 있는 몇 안 남은 수단 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Foldables remain a small slice of overall phone sales, but they have grown steadily in markets like South Korea, China, and parts of Europe, and they carry premium price tags that support higher margins.
segments.tr: 폴더블은 전체 휴대폰 판매량에서 여전히 작은 비중을 차지하지만, 한국, 중국 및 일부 유럽 시장에서 꾸준히 성장해 왔으며 높은 마진을 뒷받침하는 프리미엄 가격표를 달고 있습니다.

segments.src: Entering late gives Apple an advantage rivals didn't have: years of watching what worked and what didn't in hinge durability, crease visibility, and software adaptation for foldable screens.
segments.tr: 늦게 진입하는 것은 경쟁사들에게 없었던 이점을 애플에게 제공합니다. 즉 힌지 내구성, 주름 시인성, 폴더블 화면을 위한 소프트웨어 최적화에서 무엇이 효과적이고 무엇이 그렇지 않았는지 수년간 지켜볼 수 있었습니다.

segments.src: ## The Risks Behind the Bet
segments.tr: ## 승부수 뒤에 숨은 위험 요소

segments.src: A first-generation folding iPhone carries obvious execution risk.
segments.tr: 1세대 폴딩 iPhone은 명백한 실행 위험을 안고 있습니다.

segments.src: Hinge mechanisms are mechanically complex, foldable displays have historically been more fragile and expensive to repair, and price points for the category tend to sit well above standard flagships — a tough sell during a period when many households are watching discretionary spending closely.
segments.tr: 힌지 메커니즘은 기계적으로 복잡하고, 폴더블 디스플레이는 역사적으로 더 깨지기 쉽고 수리비가แพ쌌으며, 이 카테고리의 가격대는 일반 플래그십보다 훨씬 높게 형성되는 경향이 있습니다 — 많은 가계가 가계 지출을 긴밀히 주시하고 있는 시기에 설득하기 어려운 부분입니다.

segments.src: There's also a software question: whether iOS and the App Store ecosystem can meaningfully take advantage of a second, larger screen at launch, or whether that experience arrives gradually over future updates, as it often has with other Apple hardware categories.
segments.tr: 소프트웨어 질문도 있습니다: iOS와 App Store 생태계가 출시 시점에 더 큰 두 번째 화면을 의미 있게 활용할 수 있을지, 아니면 다른 애플 하드웨어 카테고리가 자주 그랬듯 향후 업데이트를 통해 경험이 점진적으로 도달할지 여부입니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch For
segments.tr: ## 관전 포인트

segments.src: For anyone following the event, a few numbers will matter more than the marketing language:
segments.tr: 이 행사를 지켜보는 모든 이들에게 몇 가지 숫자는 마케팅 언어보다 더 중요할 것입니다:

segments.src: - **Pricing** for the foldable model relative to existing Pro Max pricing, and what that signals about who Apple thinks will buy it.
segments.tr: - 기존 Pro Max 가격 대비 폴더블 모델의 **가격 정책**, 그리고 이것이 애플이 생각하는 주요 구매층에 대해 무엇을 시사하는지.

segments.src: - **Battery life claims** for the A20 Pro chip, since efficiency gains from a new process node don't always translate into real-world runtime improvements.
segments.tr: - 새로운 공정 노드의 효율성 향상이 항상 실제 구동 시간 개선으로 이어지는 것은 아니므로, A20 Pro 칩의 **배터리 수명 주장**.

segments.src: - **Repairability and durability details**, an area regulators and consumers alike have paid closer attention to in recent years.
segments.tr: - 최근 몇 년간 규제 기관과 소비자 모두가 더욱 주의 깊게 지켜보고 있는 분야인 **수리 가능성 및 내구성 세부 사항**.

segments.src: - **Initial availability**, since new form factors from Apple have sometimes launched in limited quantities before scaling production.
segments.tr: - 애플의 새로운 폼 팩터는 생산을 확대하기 전에 한정된 수량으로 먼저 출시되는 경우가 있었으므로, **초기 수급 상황**.

segments.src: Apple's keynote is expected to stream live on apple.com and the Apple TV app on September 9.
segments.tr: 애플의 키노트는 9월 9일 apple.com과 Apple TV 앱에서 생중계될 예정입니다.

segments.src: Until then, the details above should be treated as informed speculation rather than confirmed specifications — Apple's own presentation will be the first reliable source for what's actually shipping this fall.
segments.tr: 그때까지 위 세부 사항은 확정된 사양이 아닌 정보에 기반한 추측으로 다루어져야 합니다 — 이번 가을에 실제로 출시될 제품에 대한 첫 번째 신뢰할 수 있는 출처는 애플의 자체 발표가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What's Reportedly Coming
segments.tr: ## कथित तौर पर क्या आ रहा है

segments.src: Based on leaks circulating among display suppliers and component makers in Asia, here is the shape analysts expect the lineup to take:
segments.tr: एशिया में डिस्प्ले आपूर्तिकर्ताओं और घटक निर्माताओं के बीच चल रहे लीक के आधार पर, विश्लेषकों को उम्मीद है कि यह लाइनअप इस प्रकार का होगा:

segments.src: - **iPhone Ultra (foldable):** A book-style folding design with a crease-reduction hinge system, an outer cover display for quick tasks, and a large internal screen aimed at productivity and media use — Apple's answer to years of foldable phones from Samsung and Chinese rivals.
segments.tr: - **iPhone Ultra (फोल्डेबल):** क्रीज-रिडक्शन हिंज सिस्टम के साथ एक बुक-स्टाइल फोल्डिंग डिज़ाइन, त्वरित कार्यों के लिए एक बाहरी कवर डिस्प्ले, और उत्पादकता और मीडिया उपयोग के उद्देश्य से एक बड़ी आंतरिक स्क्रीन — सैमसंग और चीनी प्रतिद्वंद्वियों के वर्षों के फोल्डेबल फोन का Apple का जवाब।

segments.src: - **iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max:** Expected to carry the new A20 Pro chip, said to be the first Apple silicon built on a 2nm process, promising meaningful gains in efficiency and on-device AI performance.
segments.tr: - **iPhone 18 Pro और Pro Max:** इसमें नया A20 Pro चिप होने की उम्मीद है, जिसे 2nm प्रोसेस पर निर्मित पहला Apple सिलिकॉन कहा जा रहा है, जो दक्षता और ऑन-डिवाइस AI प्रदर्शन में महत्वपूर्ण लाभ का वादा करता है।

segments.src: - **Camera and battery updates:** Incremental but notable improvements are rumored across the Pro models, continuing Apple's pattern of pairing major design years with quieter internal refinements.
segments.tr: - **कैमरा और बैटरी अपडेट:** Pro मॉडल में मामूली लेकिन उल्लेखनीय सुधारों की अफवाह है, जो बड़े डिज़ाइन वर्षों को शांत आंतरिक सुधारों के साथ जोड़ने के Apple के पैटर्न को जारी रखता है।

segments.src: Apple has not confirmed any of these details publicly, and as with every pre-launch cycle, specifics could change before the keynote actually streams.

segments.src: ## Why a Foldable, Why Now
segments.tr: ## फोल्डेबल क्यों, और अभी क्यों

segments.src: The smartphone market Apple is selling into today looks very different from the one it entered in 2007.
segments.tr: स्मार्टफोन बाजार जिसमें Apple आज बेच रहा है, वह 2007 में प्रवेश किए गए बाजार से बहुत अलग दिखता है।

segments.src: Global unit growth has flattened, replacement cycles have stretched toward four years in many markets, and premium buyers increasingly ask "why upgrade?"
segments.tr: वैश्विक यूनिट वृद्धि धीमी हो गई है, कई बाजारों में रिप्लेसमेंट चक्र चार साल की ओर बढ़ गए हैं, और प्रीमियम खरीदार तेजी से पूछते हैं "अपग्रेड क्यों करें?"

segments.src: rather than "which model?"
segments.tr: बजाय इसके कि "कौन सा मॉडल लें?"

segments.src: A genuinely new form factor is one of the few levers left that can reset that calculus.
segments.tr: एक वास्तविक नया फॉर्म फैक्टर उन कुछ बचे हुए तरीकों में से एक है जो उस सोच को बदल सकता है।

segments.src: Foldables remain a small slice of overall phone sales, but they have grown steadily in markets like South Korea, China, and parts of Europe, and they carry premium price tags that support higher margins.
segments.tr: कुल फोन बिक्री में फोल्डेबल्स का हिस्सा अभी भी छोटा है, लेकिन वे दक्षिण कोरिया, चीन और यूरोप के कुछ हिस्सों जैसे बाजारों में लगातार बढ़े हैं, और वे प्रीमियम कीमतों के साथ आते हैं जो उच्च मार्जिन का समर्थन करते हैं।

segments.src: Entering late gives Apple an advantage rivals didn't have: years of watching what worked and what didn't in hinge durability, crease visibility, and software adaptation for foldable screens.
segments.tr: देर से प्रवेश करने से Apple को एक ऐसा लाभ मिलता है जो प्रतिद्वंद्वियों के पास नहीं था: फोल्डेबल स्क्रीन के लिए हिंज स्थायित्व, क्रीज दृश्यता और सॉफ्टवेयर अनुकूलन में क्या काम आया और क्या नहीं, इसे वर्षों तक देखने का मौका।

segments.src: ## The Risks Behind the Bet
segments.tr: ## इस दांव के पीछे के जोखिम

segments.src: A first-generation folding iPhone carries obvious execution risk.
segments.tr: पहली पीढ़ी के फोल्डिंग iPhone में स्पष्ट रूप से निष्पादन का जोखिम है।

segments.src: Hinge mechanisms are mechanically complex, foldable displays have historically been more fragile and expensive to repair, and price points for the category tend to sit well above standard flagships — a tough sell during a period when many households are watching discretionary spending closely.
segments.tr: हिंज तंत्र यांत्रिक रूप से जटिल होते हैं, फोल्डेबल डिस्प्ले ऐतिहासिक रूप से अधिक नाजुक और मरम्मत के लिए महंगे रहे हैं, और इस श्रेणी की कीमतें मानक फ्लैगशिप से काफी ऊपर होती हैं — ऐसे समय में जब कई परिवार विवेकाधीन खर्चों पर बारीकी से नजर रख रहे हैं, इसे बेचना एक कठिन काम है।

segments.src: There's also a software question: whether iOS and the App Store ecosystem can meaningfully take advantage of a second, larger screen at launch, or whether that experience arrives gradually over future updates, as it often has with other Apple hardware categories.
segments.tr: एक सॉफ्टवेयर का सवाल भी है: क्या iOS और App Store इकोसिस्टम लॉन्च के समय दूसरी, बड़ी स्क्रीन का सार्थक लाभ उठा सकते हैं, या क्या वह अनुभव भविष्य के अपडेट के माध्यम से धीरे-धीरे आएगा, जैसा कि अक्सर अन्य Apple हार्डवेयर श्रेणियों के साथ हुआ है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch For
segments.tr: ## किस पर नजर रखनी है

segments.tr: इवेंट को फॉलो करने वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति के लिए, मार्केटिंग भाषा से अधिक कुछ आंकड़े मायने रखेंगे:

segments.src: - **Battery life claims** for the A20 Pro chip, since efficiency gains from a new process node don't always translate into real-world runtime improvements.
segments.tr: - A20 Pro चिप के लिए **बैटरी लाइफ के दावे**, क्योंकि एक नए प्रोसेस नोड से दक्षता लाभ हमेशा वास्तविक दुनिया के रनटाइम सुधारों में अनुवादित नहीं होते हैं।

segments.src: - **Repairability and durability details**, an area regulators and consumers alike have paid closer attention to in recent years.
segments.tr: - **मरम्मत योग्यता और स्थायित्व विवरण**, एक ऐसा क्षेत्र जिस पर हाल के वर्षों में नियामकों और उपभोक्ताओं दोनों ने अधिक ध्यान दिया है।

segments.src: - **Initial availability**, since new form factors from Apple have sometimes launched in limited quantities before scaling production.
segments.tr: - **प्रारंभिक उपलब्धता**, क्योंकि Apple के नए फॉर्म फैक्टर कभी-कभी उत्पादन बढ़ाने से पहले सीमित मात्रा में लॉन्च किए गए हैं।

segments.src: Until then, the details above should be treated as informed speculation rather than confirmed specifications — Apple's own presentation will be the first reliable source for what's actually shipping this fall.
segments.tr: तब तक, उपरोक्त विवरणों को पुष्ट विशिष्टताओं के बजाय केवल जानकारीपूर्ण अटकलें माना जाना चाहिए — इस गिरावट में वास्तव में क्या आ रहा है, इसके लिए Apple की अपनी प्रस्तुति ही पहला विश्वसनीय स्रोत होगी।

fr.title: Un pli, trois téléphones : dans le pari d'Apple du 9 septembre sur l'iPhone Ultra

segments.src: Apple has invited the press to a September 9 event billed internally, according to multiple supply-chain and media reports, as "Surprise and Shine" — and the surprise this year looks bigger than a new camera bump or a fresh color option.
segments.tr: Apple a invité la presse à un événement le 9 septembre présenté en interne, selon plusieurs rapports de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et des médias, comme "Surprise and Shine" — et la surprise de cette année s'annonce plus grande qu'une nouvelle bosse de caméra ou une nouvelle option de couleur.

segments.src: For the first time in the iPhone's history, Apple is reportedly preparing to ship a folding handset, arriving alongside a refreshed iPhone 18 Pro lineup built on a new 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip.
segments.tr: Pour la première fois dans l'histoire de l'iPhone, Apple se préparerait à commercialiser un combiné pliable, arrivant aux côtés d'une gamme actualisée iPhone 18 Pro construite sur une nouvelle puce A20 Pro à 2 nanomètres.

segments.src: If the reports hold up, it would mark the most significant hardware shift for the iPhone since the move to Face ID in 2017 — and a calculated gamble at a moment when global smartphone upgrade cycles have grown longer and harder to disrupt.
segments.tr: Si les rapports s'avèrent exacts, cela marquerait le changement matériel le plus important pour l'iPhone depuis le passage à Face ID en 2017 — et un pari calculé à un moment où les cycles de mise à niveau des smartphones mondiaux sont devenus plus longs et plus difficiles à perturber.

segments.src: ## What's Reportedly Coming
segments.tr: ## Ce qui est annoncé

segments.src: Based on leaks circulating among display suppliers and component makers in Asia, here is the shape analysts expect the lineup to take:
segments.tr: Sur la base des fuites circulant parmi les fournisseurs d'écrans et les fabricants de composants en Asie, voici la forme que les analystes attendent pour la gamme :

segments.src: - **iPhone Ultra (foldable):** A book-style folding design with a crease-reduction hinge system, an outer cover display for quick tasks, and a large internal screen aimed at productivity and media use — Apple's answer to years of foldable phones from Samsung and Chinese rivals.
segments.tr: - **iPhone Ultra (pliable) :** Un design pliable de type livre avec un système de charnière réduisant les pliures, un écran de couverture externe pour les tâches rapides et un grand écran interne destiné à la productivité et à l'utilisation multimédia — la réponse d'Apple à des années de téléphones pliables de Samsung et de rivaux chinois.

segments.src: - **iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max:** Expected to carry the new A20 Pro chip, said to be the first Apple silicon built on a 2nm process, promising meaningful gains in efficiency and on-device AI performance.
segments.tr: - **iPhone 18 Pro et Pro Max :** Devraient embarquer la nouvelle puce A20 Pro, présentée comme le premier silicium d'Apple construit sur un processus de 2 nm, promettant des gains significatifs en matière d'efficacité et de performance d'IA sur l'appareil.

segments.src: - **Camera and battery updates:** Incremental but notable improvements are rumored across the Pro models, continuing Apple's pattern of pairing major design years with quieter internal refinements.
segments.tr: - **Mises à jour de l'appareil photo et de la batterie :** Des améliorations progressives mais notables sont pressenties sur les modèles Pro, poursuivant le schéma d'Apple consistant à associer des années de conception majeures à des raffinements internes plus discrets.

segments.src: Apple has not confirmed any of these details publicly, and as with every pre-launch cycle, specifics could change before the keynote actually streams.
segments.tr: Apple n'a confirmé aucun de ces détails publiquement et, comme pour chaque cycle de pré-lancement, les spécificités pourraient changer avant la diffusion réelle de la keynote.

segments.tr: ## Pourquoi un pliable, pourquoi maintenant

segments.src: The smartphone market Apple is selling into today looks very different from the one it entered in 2007.
segments.tr: Le marché des smartphones sur lequel Apple vend aujourd'hui est très différent de celui qu'elle a rejoint en 2007.

segments.src: Global unit growth has flattened, replacement cycles have stretched toward four years in many markets, and premium buyers increasingly ask "why upgrade?"
segments.tr: La croissance mondiale des unités s'est aplatie, les cycles de remplacement se sont étirés vers quatre ans sur de nombreux marchés, et les acheteurs haut de gamme demandent de plus en plus "pourquoi mettre à niveau ?"

segments.src: rather than "which model?"
segments.tr: plutôt que "quel modèle ?"

segments.src: A genuinely new form factor is one of the few levers left that can reset that calculus.
segments.tr: Un nouveau facteur de forme authentique est l'un des rares leviers restants capables de réinitialiser ce calcul.

segments.src: Foldables remain a small slice of overall phone sales, but they have grown steadily in markets like South Korea, China, and parts of Europe, and they carry premium price tags that support higher margins.
segments.tr: Les pliables restent une petite part des ventes totales de téléphones, mais ils ont connu une croissance régulière sur des marchés comme la Corée du Sud, la Chine et certaines parts de l'Europe, et ils affichent des prix élevés qui soutiennent des marges plus importantes.

segments.src: Entering late gives Apple an advantage rivals didn't have: years of watching what worked and what didn't in hinge durability, crease visibility, and software adaptation for foldable screens.
segments.tr: Entrer tardivement donne à Apple un avantage que les rivaux n'avaient pas : des années à observer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui n'a pas fonctionné en matière de durabilité des charnières, de visibilité des plis et d'adaptation logicielle pour les écrans pliables.

segments.tr: ## Les risques derrière le pari

segments.tr: Un iPhone pliable de première génération comporte un risque d'exécution évident.

segments.tr: Les mécanismes de charnière sont complexes sur le plan mécanique, les écrans pliables ont historiquement été plus fragiles et plus coûteux à réparer, et les prix de la catégorie ont tendance à se situer bien au-dessus des produits phares standard — une vente difficile pendant une période où de nombreux ménages surveillent de près leurs dépenses discrétionnaires.

segments.src: There's also a software question: whether iOS and the App Store ecosystem can meaningfully take advantage of a second, larger screen at launch, or whether that experience arrives gradually over future updates, as it often has with other Apple hardware categories.
segments.tr: Il y a aussi une question logicielle : savoir si iOS et l'écosystème de l'App Store peuvent tirer pleinement parti d'un deuxième écran plus grand au lancement, ou si cette expérience arrive progressivement au fil des futures mises à jour, comme cela a souvent été le cas avec d'autres catégories de matériel Apple.

in.title: Satu Lipatan, Tiga Ponsel: Di Balik Taruhan Apple pada 9 September untuk iPhone Ultra

segments.src: Apple has invited the press to a September 9 event billed internally, according to multiple supply-chain and media reports, as "Surprise and Shine" — and the surprise this year looks bigger than a new camera bump or a fresh color option.
segments.tr: Apple telah mengundang pers ke acara 9 September yang secara internal disebut, menurut beberapa laporan rantai pasokan dan media, sebagai "Surprise and Shine" — dan kejutan tahun ini terlihat lebih besar daripada sekadar tonjolan kamera baru atau pilihan warna baru.

segments.src: For the first time in the iPhone's history, Apple is reportedly preparing to ship a folding handset, arriving alongside a refreshed iPhone 18 Pro lineup built on a new 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip.
segments.tr: Untuk pertama kalinya dalam sejarah iPhone, Apple dilaporkan bersiap untuk meluncurkan ponsel lipat, yang hadir bersamaan dengan jajaran iPhone 18 Pro yang diperbarui yang dibangun di atas chip A20 Pro 2-nanometer baru.

segments.src: If the reports hold up, it would mark the most significant hardware shift for the iPhone since the move to Face ID in 2017 — and a calculated gamble at a moment when global smartphone upgrade cycles have grown longer and harder to disrupt.
segments.tr: Jika laporan tersebut benar, ini akan menandai pergeseran perangkat keras paling signifikan untuk iPhone sejak beralih ke Face ID pada tahun 2017 — dan sebuah taruhan yang terhitung pada saat siklus pembaruan smartphone global menjadi lebih panjang dan semakin sulit diguncang.

segments.src: ## What's Reportedly Coming
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dilaporkan Akan Hadir

segments.src: Based on leaks circulating among display suppliers and component makers in Asia, here is the shape analysts expect the lineup to take:
segments.tr: Berdasarkan bocoran yang beredar di antara pemasok layar dan pembuat komponen di Asia, berikut adalah gambaran yang diperkirakan para analis untuk jajaran tersebut:

segments.src: - **iPhone Ultra (foldable):** A book-style folding design with a crease-reduction hinge system, an outer cover display for quick tasks, and a large internal screen aimed at productivity and media use — Apple's answer to years of foldable phones from Samsung and Chinese rivals.
segments.tr: - **iPhone Ultra (dapat dilipat):** Desain lipat bergaya buku dengan sistem engsel pengurangan lipatan, layar cover luar untuk tugas cepat, dan layar internal besar yang ditujukan untuk produktivitas dan penggunaan media — jawaban Apple terhadap ponsel lipat bertahun-tahun dari Samsung dan rival asal Tiongkok.

segments.src: - **iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max:** Expected to carry the new A20 Pro chip, said to be the first Apple silicon built on a 2nm process, promising meaningful gains in efficiency and on-device AI performance.
segments.tr: - **iPhone 18 Pro dan Pro Max:** Diperkirakan membawa chip A20 Pro baru, yang dikatakan sebagai Apple silicon pertama yang dibangun pada proses 2nm, menjanjikan peningkatan signifikan dalam efisiensi dan performa AI pada perangkat.

segments.src: - **Camera and battery updates:** Incremental but notable improvements are rumored across the Pro models, continuing Apple's pattern of pairing major design years with quieter internal refinements.
segments.tr: - **Pembaruan kamera dan baterai:** Peningkatan bertahap namun signifikan dirumorkan ada di seluruh model Pro, melanjutkan pola Apple yang memasangkan tahun-tahun desain besar dengan penyempurnaan internal yang lebih tenang.

segments.src: Apple has not confirmed any of these details publicly, and as with every pre-launch cycle, specifics could change before the keynote actually streams.
segments.tr: Apple belum mengonfirmasi detail ini secara publik, dan seperti halnya setiap siklus pra-peluncuran, rincian dapat berubah sebelum acara utama benar-benar disiarkan secara langsung.

segments.src: ## Why a Foldable, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Ponsel Lipat, Mengapa Sekarang

segments.src: The smartphone market Apple is selling into today looks very different from the one it entered in 2007.
segments.tr: Pasar smartphone yang dituju Apple saat ini terlihat sangat berbeda dari pasar yang dimasukinya pada tahun 2007.

segments.src: Global unit growth has flattened, replacement cycles have stretched toward four years in many markets, and premium buyers increasingly ask "why upgrade?"
segments.tr: Pertumbuhan unit global telah mendatar, siklus penggantian telah membentang mendekati empat tahun di banyak pasar, dan pembeli kelas premium semakin sering bertanya "mengapa perlu memperbarui?"

segments.src: rather than "which model?"
segments.tr: daripada "model yang mana?"

segments.src: A genuinely new form factor is one of the few levers left that can reset that calculus.
segments.tr: Form factor yang benar-benar baru adalah salah satu dari sedikit tuas tersisa yang dapat mengubah perhitungan tersebut.

segments.src: Foldables remain a small slice of overall phone sales, but they have grown steadily in markets like South Korea, China, and parts of Europe, and they carry premium price tags that support higher margins.
segments.tr: Ponsel lipat masih menjadi bagian kecil dari keseluruhan penjualan ponsel, tetapi mereka telah tumbuh secara stabil di pasar seperti Korea Selatan, Tiongkok, dan sebagian Eropa, serta membawa label harga premium yang mendukung margin lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Entering late gives Apple an advantage rivals didn't have: years of watching what worked and what didn't in hinge durability, crease visibility, and software adaptation for foldable screens.
segments.tr: Masuk belakangan memberi Apple keunggulan yang tidak dimiliki para pesaing: bertahun-tahun mengamati apa yang berhasil dan apa yang tidak dalam hal daya tahan engsel, visibilitas lipatan, dan adaptasi perangkat lunak untuk layar lipat.

segments.src: ## The Risks Behind the Bet
segments.tr: ## Risiko di Balik Taruhan

segments.src: A first-generation folding iPhone carries obvious execution risk.
segments.tr: iPhone lipat generasi pertama membawa risiko eksekusi yang jelas.

segments.src: Hinge mechanisms are mechanically complex, foldable displays have historically been more fragile and expensive to repair, and price points for the category tend to sit well above standard flagships — a tough sell during a period when many households are watching discretionary spending closely.
segments.tr: Mekanisme engsel secara mekanik rumit, layar lipat secara historis lebih rapuh dan mahal untuk diperbaiki, dan titik harga untuk kategori ini cenderung jauh di atas flagship standar — penjualan yang sulit di periode ketika banyak rumah tangga mengawasi pengeluaran diskresioner dengan ketat.

segments.src: There's also a software question: whether iOS and the App Store ecosystem can meaningfully take advantage of a second, larger screen at launch, or whether that experience arrives gradually over future updates, as it often has with other Apple hardware categories.
segments.tr: Ada juga pertanyaan tentang perangkat lunak: apakah iOS dan ekosistem App Store dapat memanfaatkan layar kedua yang lebih besar secara signifikan saat peluncuran, atau apakah pengalaman tersebut hadir secara bertahap melalui pembaruan di masa mendatang, seperti yang sering terjadi pada kategori perangkat keras Apple lainnya.

segments.tr: - **Ketersediaan awal**, karena form factor baru dari Apple terkadang diluncurkan dalam jumlah terbatas sebelum meningkatkan skala produksi.

vi.title: Một màn hình gập, ba chiếc điện thoại: Phía sau canh bạc ngày 9 tháng 9 của Apple với iPhone Ultra

segments.src: Apple has invited the press to a September 9 event billed internally, according to multiple supply-chain and media reports, as "Surprise and Shine" — and the surprise this year looks bigger than a new camera bump or a fresh color option.
segments.tr: Apple đã mời báo chí tham dự sự kiện ngày 9 tháng 9 mà theo nhiều nguồn tin từ chuỗi cung ứng và truyền thông gọi nội bộ là "Surprise and Shine" (Bất ngờ và Tỏa sáng) — và điều bất ngờ năm nay có vẻ lớn hơn một cụm camera mới hay một tùy chọn màu sắc mới.

segments.src: For the first time in the iPhone's history, Apple is reportedly preparing to ship a folding handset, arriving alongside a refreshed iPhone 18 Pro lineup built on a new 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip.
segments.tr: Lần đầu tiên trong lịch sử của iPhone, Apple được cho là đang chuẩn bị ra mắt một chiếc điện thoại gập, xuất hiện cùng với dòng iPhone 18 Pro được làm mới dựa trên con chip A20 Pro 2-nanometer mới.

segments.src: If the reports hold up, it would mark the most significant hardware shift for the iPhone since the move to Face ID in 2017 — and a calculated gamble at a moment when global smartphone upgrade cycles have grown longer and harder to disrupt.
segments.tr: Nếu các báo cáo này chính xác, đây sẽ đánh dấu sự thay đổi phần cứng quan trọng nhất đối với iPhone kể từ khi chuyển sang Face ID vào năm 2017 — đồng thời là một canh bạc được tính toán kỹ lưỡng vào thời điểm chu kỳ nâng cấp điện thoại thông minh toàn cầu ngày càng kéo dài và khó tạo đột phá hơn.

segments.src: ## What's Reportedly Coming
segments.tr: ## Những gì được cho là sẽ ra mắt

segments.src: Based on leaks circulating among display suppliers and component makers in Asia, here is the shape analysts expect the lineup to take:
segments.tr: Dựa trên các thông tin rò rỉ lan truyền giữa các nhà cung cấp màn hình và nhà sản xuất linh kiện ở Châu Á, đây là hình dáng mà các nhà phân tích dự kiến dòng sản phẩm sẽ có:

segments.src: - **iPhone Ultra (foldable):** A book-style folding design with a crease-reduction hinge system, an outer cover display for quick tasks, and a large internal screen aimed at productivity and media use — Apple's answer to years of foldable phones from Samsung and Chinese rivals.
segments.tr: - **iPhone Ultra (gập):** Thiết kế gập dạng cuốn sách với hệ thống bản lề giảm nếp nhăn, màn hình ngoài để thực hiện các tác vụ nhanh, và màn hình lớn bên trong hướng tới năng suất và giải trí — câu trả lời của Apple cho nhiều năm có điện thoại gập từ Samsung và các đối thủ Trung Quốc.

segments.src: - **iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max:** Expected to carry the new A20 Pro chip, said to be the first Apple silicon built on a 2nm process, promising meaningful gains in efficiency and on-device AI performance.
segments.tr: - **iPhone 18 Pro và Pro Max:** Dự kiến sẽ mang chip A20 Pro mới, được cho là dòng silicon đầu tiên của Apple được xây dựng trên tiến trình 2nm, hứa hẹn mang lại những cải thiện đáng kể về hiệug suất và khả năng AI trên thiết bị.

segments.src: - **Camera and battery updates:** Incremental but notable improvements are rumored across the Pro models, continuing Apple's pattern of pairing major design years with quieter internal refinements.
segments.tr: - **Cập nhật camera và pin:** Những cải tiến nhỏ nhưng đáng chú ý được đồn đại trên các mẫu Pro, tiếp tục mô hình kết hợp các năm thiết kế lớn với các cải tiến bên trong âm thầm hơn của Apple.

segments.src: Apple has not confirmed any of these details publicly, and as with every pre-launch cycle, specifics could change before the keynote actually streams.
segments.tr: Apple chưa xác nhận bất kỳ chi tiết nào trong số này một cách công khai, và giống như mọi chu kỳ trước khi ra mắt, các chi tiết cụ thể có thể thay đổi trước khi sự kiện chính thức được phát sóng.

segments.src: ## Why a Foldable, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lại là điện thoại gập, tại sao lại là bây giờ

segments.src: The smartphone market Apple is selling into today looks very different from the one it entered in 2007.
segments.tr: Thị trường điện thoại thông minh mà Apple đang bán hàng ngày nay trông rất khác so với thời điểm hãng gia nhập vào năm 2007.

segments.src: Global unit growth has flattened, replacement cycles have stretched toward four years in many markets, and premium buyers increasingly ask "why upgrade?"
segments.tr: Sự tăng trưởng về số lượng đơn vị toàn cầu đã chững lại, chu kỳ thay thế đã kéo dài hướng tới bốn năm ở nhiều thị trường, và những người mua cao cấp ngày càng đặt câu hỏi "tại sao phải nâng cấp?"

segments.src: rather than "which model?"
segments.tr: hơn là "chọn mẫu nào?"

segments.src: A genuinely new form factor is one of the few levers left that can reset that calculus.
segments.tr: Một yếu tố hình thức hoàn toàn mới là một trong số ít đòn bẩy còn lại có thể thiết lập lại phép tính đó.

segments.src: Foldables remain a small slice of overall phone sales, but they have grown steadily in markets like South Korea, China, and parts of Europe, and they carry premium price tags that support higher margins.
segments.tr: Điện thoại gập vẫn chiếm một phần nhỏ trong tổng số doanh số điện thoại, nhưng chúng đã phát triển đều đặn ở các thị trường như Hàn Quốc, Trung Quốc và một số khu vực ở Châu Âu, đồng thời mang mức giá cao cấp hỗ trợ biên lợi nhuận cao hơn.

segments.src: Entering late gives Apple an advantage rivals didn't have: years of watching what worked and what didn't in hinge durability, crease visibility, and software adaptation for foldable screens.
segments.tr: Việc gia nhập muộn mang lại cho Apple một lợi thế mà các đối thủ không có: nhiều năm quan sát những gì đã thành công và những gì chưa thành công về độ bền bản lề, khả năng hiển thị nếp nhăn và sự thích ứng phần mềm cho màn hình gập.

segments.src: There's also a software question: whether iOS and the App Store ecosystem can meaningfully take advantage of a second, larger screen at launch, or whether that experience arrives gradually over future updates, as it often has with other Apple hardware categories.
segments.tr: Cũng có một câu hỏi về phần mềm: liệu iOS và hệ sinh thái App Store có thể tận dụng một cách ý nghĩa màn hình thứ hai, lớn hơn khi ra mắt hay không, hoặc trải nghiệm đó sẽ đến dần dần qua các bản cập nhật trong tương lai, giống như thường lệ với các danh mục phần cứng khác của Apple.
